profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, traded under the ticker EFX, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000033185. Its website describes it as a credit bureau offering credit reports and credit scores to both businesses and consumers, alongside identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts. The company markets a product called Equifax Complete, and says that customers who become victims of identity theft are assigned dedicated ID Restoration Specialists who work on their behalf toward recovery.

The site's consumer-facing material is largely educational. It covers how financial behavior affects credit, what appears on a credit report and why, warning signs of fraud and identity theft, types of debt, credit cards and card debt, personal finance and saving, and the different types of loans including personal and student loans and the considerations around co-signing. It also offers Spanish-language information on Equifax credit reports in the United States, credit scores, and money management.

The material does not describe any AI products or services. On the litigation side, the company's recorded exposure sits in Georgia, with 98 cases. No products or MCP servers are tracked for the company in the data provided.
